title: InSet-Eco: An Indonesian Sentiment Lexicon for Coastal Tourism Reviews in the Riau Islands
description: InSet-Eco is an Indonesian sentiment lexicon adapted from InSet (Koto & Rahmaningtyas, 2017) for online reviews of beaches, mangroves, and fishing areas in the Riau Islands, Indonesia. It contains 12,717 entries (single words and two- or three-word phrases), each scored from −5 to +5: 2,926 new domain entries scored from 6,124 star-rated Google Maps reviews, 128 revised InSet entries, 46 neutralized function words, 1,386 non-standard spellings, and the unchanged InSet entries. Validated spelling-correction resources (1,519 annotator-validated pairs) are included. The lexicon is described and evaluated in Chahyadi et al., BIO Web of Conferences 262, 03011 (2026).
references: F. Koto, G.Y. Rahmaningtyas, InSet Lexicon: Evaluation of a Word List for Indonesian Sentiment Analysis in Microblogs, in Proc. IALP (IEEE, 2017), pp. 391-394.
notes: Funded by the Universitas Maritim Raja Ali Haji (UMRAH) Fundamental Research Grant 2026.
